description.zh: 明日方舟：终末地的陈千语，改编为卫戍协议的剑豪近卫。当弃即弃：她每击杀一名敌人，己方狙击（射手）干员叠加攻击力，每层再使自身攻击范围向前、上、下、后各延伸1格。新盟约【钢板】：陈千语、能天使、新约能天使、蕾缪安、莫斯提马、小满、塑心、赫默、夕、华法琳、泡泡、铃兰、古米、佩佩、妮芙、蒂比、忍冬、惊蛰，在场2/4/6/8名时攻击速度与防御力提升，盟约激活时每层层数再使防御力+20。不演了：在场至少6名不同【钢板】干员时，她造成的所有伤害变为真实伤害。特性：每次造成伤害时叠加防御力与法术抗性。新策略「陈千语」（20生命）【当当】：第1回合获得陈千语；场上存在6种以上激活盟约时，所有干员无视80%的防御力和法术抗性。
description.en: Chen Qianyu from Arknights: Endfield as a Swordmaster guard. Dangqi Jiqi (当弃即弃): each enemy she kills stacks ATK on your Sniper operators, and each stack widens her range a tile forward, up, down and back. New bond Steel Plate (钢板): Chen Qianyu, Exusiai, Exusiai the New Covenant, Lemuen, Mostima, Xiaoman, Virtuosa, Silence, Dusk, Warfarin, Bubble, Suzuran, Gummy, Pepe, Nymph, Tippi, Vulpisfoglia and Leizi gain attack speed and DEF with 2/4/6/8 on the field, and +20 DEF per layer of the bond while it is active. Done Pretending (不演了): with 6 or more Steel Plate operators on the field, all the damage she deals is true damage. Trait: every hit she deals stacks DEF and RES on her. New strategy Chen Qianyu (20 LP), Dang Dang (当当): Chen Qianyu joins in round 1; with 6 or more active bonds on the field, every operator ignores 80% of DEF and RES.
